column1: # Frozen before a single abbreviation table entry exists, per the freeze
# Not edited after the freeze: not to add a case the table misses, not to
# reword one. The unsupported-match control is drawn from this same file.
# Written from plausible operator phrasing, not from the shipped catalogue's
# term list. No case carries a supported/unsupported label — labelling at
# freeze time is the leak the protocol exists to prevent. The supported
# fraction is whatever the table turns out to cover, and a run that resolves
# every case is reported as leakage rather than as a pass.
# Format: query<TAB>intended_tool. Tools live in catalogue.tsv.
